caption.claude-code: Claude Code asks before edits and most commands, so OverBench answers each.
caption.codex: Codex keeps its own sandbox: Edit the project also runs commands inside the project without asking; leaving the project or reaching the network asks.

caption.pi: Pi does not ask before it acts, so OverBench cannot hold it to this scope.
